headline: Margins expand sharply while revenue dips year over year
summary_short: Constellation Brands' revenue fell 3.3% y/y to $2,432.7M in FY2026 Q2, but operating income rose 18.4% to $845.3M and net income climbed 26.7% to $653.8M, lifting diluted EPS to $3.79 (+30.7% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue declined 3.3% y/y to $2,432.7M even as gross profit rose 4.3% to $1,320.6M, implying roughly 390bp of gross-margin expansion. Operating income rose 18.4% to $845.3M and EBITDA rose 15.7% to $945.3M. Net income climbed 26.7% to $653.8M and pretax income rose 24.3% to $760.0M; diluted EPS rose 30.7% to $3.79. Operating cash flow rose 3.9% y/y to $661.8M while capex fell 8.1% to $177.2M.
